summary: FIFA announced that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica will co-host the 2031 tournament, while the UK will host in 2035.
paragraphs: According to DW and Euronews, FIFA has confirmed that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica will jointly host the 2031 Women's World Cup, which will mark the first time the tournament features 48 teams.

Euronews and DW also reported that the United Kingdom has been chosen to stage the 2035 Women's World Cup, with chief executives from the English, Northern Irish, Scottish, and Welsh football associations calling it a landmark moment in a joint statement.

title: Marc Marquez Claims Record-Equalizing Eighth MotoGP Title
summary: Marc Marquez secured his eighth MotoGP world title in Portimao and received a golden helmet from Giacomo Agostini.
paragraphs: BBC News reported that Marc Marquez clinched a record-equalizing eighth MotoGP world title during a race weekend in Portimao, Portugal.
